units.source_text: 雖然我曾認為處女的美，不過是書呆子詩人天真爛漫的感傷幻想，沒想到在這個世界上還真的存在。

en.t: Although I had once thought that the beauty of virginity was nothing more than the naive sentimental fantasy of bookish poets, I found that it really did exist in this world.

units.source_text: 結婚以後，等春天來到時，兩個人就可以騎自行車一起去看青葉瀑布。

en.t: After we were married, when spring came, the two of us could ride bicycles together to see the Aoba waterfall.

units.source_text: 那時，我會當場下定決心，也就是所謂的「一決勝負」的心理，毫不猶豫地盜走這朵花。

en.t: At that moment I would make up my mind on the spot, in the spirit of what people call a do-or-die match, and steal away this flower without hesitation.

units.source_text: 從中得到的喜悅並非如想象的那麼大，

en.t: The joy I gained from it was not as great as I had imagined,

units.source_text: 但之後降臨的悲哀，卻大得超乎想象，是悽慘這兩個字都無法形容的。

en.t: but the sorrow that descended afterward was far greater than I could have imagined, beyond even the word wretched to describe.
